title: Localizing closure of the tensor comparison predicate
statement: Let R,A,B,C be commutative rings in a universe u, A and B commutative R-algebras, and C an algebra over E=A tensor_R B. Use the derived categories of R-, A- and B-modules. Let Q be a cochain complex of A-modules, N a cochain complex of C-modules, F termwise scalar extension along A to E to C, and t:F(Q) to N a chain map. Assume Q is K-flat over A and C is flat over E. The predicate P of [def-pc-localized-tensor-comparison-property] is closed under coproducts indexed by any type in universe u, under the third vertex of a distinguished triangle whose first two vertices satisfy P, and under retracts (if X is a retract of Y and P(Y), then P(X)). This closure assertion has no hypothesis that t or the localized comparison for Q is invertible.

proof.text: Apply the coproduct closure component to obtain the first conjunct. Apply the triangle and retract closure components to obtain the second and third conjuncts. Assemble the three conjuncts without changing any hypothesis or conclusion. This is a decomposition, not a net closure of proof holes.

theorem localizedTensorComparisonProperty_closure
    (hC : Module.Flat (A ⊗[R] B) C)
    (hQ : ∀ V : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ, V.Acyclic →
      (CochainComplex.mapBifunctor V Q (curriedTensor _)).Acyclic) :
    let P := localizedTensorComparisonProperty R A B C Q N t
    (∀ {I : Type u} (G : I → DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A))
      (S : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A)) (ι : ∀ i : I, G i ⟶ S),
      CategoryTheory.Limits.IsColimit (CategoryTheory.Limits.Cofan.mk S ι) →
      (∀ i : I, P (G i)) → P S) ∧
    (∀ T : Pretriangulated.Triangle (DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A)),
      T ∈ Pretriangulated.distinguishedTriangles → P T.obj₁ → P T.obj₂ → P T.obj₃) ∧
    (∀ {X Y : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A)}, Retract X Y → P Y → P X)
